outcome: Neopterin levels in maternal serum and amniotic fluid
Indoleamine-2,3-dioxygenase (IDO) levels in maternal serum and amniotic fluid
YKL-40 levels in maternal serum and amniotic fluid
cohort: The study included pregnancies diagnosed with Trisomy-21 and chromosomally normal pregnancies serving as controls.
finding: Trisomy-21 pregnancies exhibited significantly higher neopterin levels in amniotic fluid and YKL-40 levels in maternal serum, while IDO levels did not show a significant difference between groups.
cross-section timing: During pregnancy (at the time of diagnosis/sampling)
